controles.affirmation: Dossier FTC : la cour d'appel du cinquieme circuit a annule la decision le 20 mars 2026 mais l'a renvoyee a la FTC ; Intuit entend continuer a defendre sa position et la resolution pourrait impliquer des couts significatifs
controles.verbatim_source: On March 20, 2026, the Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit issued a decision that vacated the FTC's order and remanded the case to the FTC. We intend to continue to defend our position on the merits of this case. However, the defense and resolution of this matter could involve significant costs. (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 11)

controles.affirmation: Le dossier a deja coute 141 M$ PAYES EN MAI 2022 aux procureurs des 50 Etats et du district de Columbia
controles.verbatim_source: on May 4, 2022, we entered into a settlement agreement with the attorneys general of the 50 states and the District of Columbia... we agreed to pay $141 million... We recorded this as a one-time charge in the quarter ended April 30, 2022, and paid the full amount to the fund administrator in the quarter ended January 31, 2023. (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 11)
controles.correction_proposee: Mai 2022 est la date de l'ACCORD, pas du paiement. Le versement est intervenu au trimestre clos le 31 janvier 2023. Ecrire : '141 M$ d'accord signe en mai 2022, verses au trimestre clos en janvier 2023'.

controles.affirmation: La decision FTC de janvier 2024 contraignait Intuit a modifier son marketing
controles.verbatim_source: On January 19, 2024, the FTC Commissioners affirmed the ALJ's decision and issued a final order that required us to adhere to certain marketing practices and did not contain any monetary penalties. (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 11)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance disponible : l'ordre ne comportait aucune penalite financiere ('did not contain any monetary penalties'), non mentionne par l'ATT.

controles.affirmation: Une action collective deposee au Canada en aout 2022 reste pendante et Intuit ne peut estimer une perte raisonnablement possible
controles.verbatim_source: a class action lawsuit that was filed in the Ontario (Canada) Superior Court of Justice on August 25, 2022 ... we are unable to estimate a reasonably possible financial loss or range of financial loss (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 11)

controles.affirmation: Concurrence du secteur public qualifiee de significative et croissante ; systeme de declaration directe gratuite de l'IRS suspendu mais partisans continuant de plaider ; IRS Free File pouvant s'etendre ; gouvernements concurrents finances par l'argent public
controles.verbatim_source: Our consumer tax business also faces significant, increasing competition from the public sector ... although the IRS free direct filing system was suspended, proponents of these programs continue to advocate for them. Additionally, the legacy IRS Free File Program enables the IRS to offer free commercial tax software directly to qualifying taxpayers, and taxpayer adoption of this program could expand ... federal and state governments are or could become publicly funded direct competitors (10-Q T3 FY2026, Item 1A)

controles.affirmation: Plan annonce le 20 mai 2026 de reduire les effectifs a temps plein d'environ 17%, cout de 300 a 340 M$ au T4 FY2026, dans le meme document que les resultats trimestriels
controles.verbatim_source: the Company will reduce its full-time workforce by approximately 17% and is considering the closure of certain of its sites ... approximately $300 million to $340 million in charges ... primarily in its fourth fiscal quarter ending July 31, 2026 (8-K du 20 mai 2026, Item 2.05 ; le meme 8-K porte l'Item 2.02 RESULTS OF OPERATIONS). Effectif 'approximately 18,200 employees' (10-K FY2025).
controles.correction_proposee: Precision utile : le 10-Q du meme jour reprend le plan mais SANS le chiffre de 17% ('we will reduce our full-time workforce'). Le 17% figure uniquement dans le 8-K.

controles.affirmation: Le chiffre d'affaires Consumer progresse partiellement compense par une baisse liee a un nombre inferieur de declarations federales TurboTax, formule employee deux fois
controles.verbatim_source: Consumer segment revenue increased 8% due to growth in assisted tax and our consumer money offerings, and strength in our Credit Karma personal loan and insurance verticals, partially offset by a decrease in revenue due to fewer TurboTax federal units (10-Q T3 FY2026, MD&A)
controles.correction_proposee: La formule apparait en realite QUATRE fois (MD&A trimestre, MD&A neuf mois, Segment Results trimestre, Segment Results neuf mois). L'ATT sous-estime, pas d'exageration.

controles.affirmation: Rachats de prets aux entreprises 4,3 Mds$ contre 2,4 Mds$ ; passages en perte 128 M$ contre 60 M$ ; dotation 148 M$ contre 83 M$ ; provision 134 M$ contre 100 M$
controles.verbatim_source: we purchased business loans from our originating bank partner with principal balances in the amount of $4.3 billion and $2.4 billion, respectively ... Provision for expected credit losses 61 30 148 83 / Charge-offs (53) (24) (128) (60) / Ending balance $134 $93 (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 4)

controles.affirmation: La provision passe de 6,7% a 8,9% de l'encours
controles.verbatim_source: the net balance of business loans held for investment was $1.5 billion, which is net of an allowance for credit losses as of April 30, 2026 and July 31, 2025 of $134 million and $100 million, respectively (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 4)
controles.correction_proposee: Deux defauts de methode : (1) le denominateur 1,5 Md$ est arrondi a deux chiffres significatifs et identique aux deux dates dans le filing, ce qui interdit une precision au dixieme de point ; (2) ce 1,5 Md$ est un encours NET de la provision, donc la provision est comparee a un encours dont elle a deja ete deduite. Sur encours brut la progression est de 6,3% a 8,2%. Ecrire : 'la provision passe de 100 a 134 M$ sur un encours net reste autour de 1,5 Md$, soit environ 6% a 8% de l'encours'.

controles.affirmation: 94% du chiffre d'affaires vient des Etats-Unis ; international 6% du trimestre et 7% des neuf mois
controles.verbatim_source: Total international net revenue was approximately 6% and 7% of consolidated net revenue for the three and nine months ended April 30, 2026, respectively. Total international net revenue was approximately 5% and 7% ... for the three and nine months ended April 30, 2025 (10-Q T3 FY2026)
controles.correction_proposee: Nuance omise : la part internationale MONTE (5% -> 6% sur le trimestre), la dependance aux Etats-Unis se reduit legerement plutot qu'elle ne s'aggrave.

controles.affirmation: Reclassement de 456 M$ de charges Consumer sur neuf mois FY2025 vers les frais de siege, dont 155 M$ sur le seul T3 ; fusion des trois segments au 1er aout 2025
controles.verbatim_source: Effective August 1, 2025, we combined our Consumer, Credit Karma, and ProTax businesses into a single Consumer segment ... we reclassified expenses totaling $1 million and $7 million from Global Business Solutions and $155 million and $456 million from Consumer to other corporate expenses (10-Q T3 FY2026, note 12)
controles.correction_proposee: L'ATT reconnait deja que les periodes anterieures ont ete retraitees ('We have recast certain previously reported amounts'). Conforme.

controles.affirmation: Emission de 1,75 Md$ le 11 juin 2026 : 750 M$ a 4,950% echeance 2031 et 1 000 M$ a 5,500% echeance 2036, produit net ~1,74 Md$, refinancement possible du 5,250% 2026 et du 1,350% 2027
controles.verbatim_source: On June 11, 2026, Intuit Inc. issued $750,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 4.950% Senior Notes due 2031 and $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 5.500% Senior Notes due 2036 ... net proceeds from the offering are approximately $1.74 billion ... which may include the refinancing of its $750 million aggregate principal amount of 5.250% Senior Notes due 2026 and $500 million aggregate principal amount of 1.350% Senior Notes due 2027 (8-K du 11 juin 2026)
